name: diseasy-ci
postCreateCommand: if [ ! -d /home/rstudio/.bash_it ]; then git clone --depth=1 --branch v3.2.0 https://github.com/Bash-it/bash-it.git /home/rstudio/.bash_it; fi && /home/rstudio/.bash_it/install.sh --no-modify-config && grep -qxF 'source /home/rstudio/.bash_it/bash_it.sh' /home/rstudio/.bashrc || echo 'source /home/rstudio/.bash_it/bash_it.sh' >> /home/rstudio/.bashrc && git config --global core.editor 'code --wait'
